typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	CAERPTS_InitialCatalog as string (),
	CAERPTS_PWD as string (),
	CAERPTS_SRVR as string (),
	CAERPTS_USER as string (),
	DaysBack as integer (),
	ENRL_InitialCatalog as string (),
	ENRL_PWD as string (),
	ENRL_SRVR as string (),
	ENRL_USER as string (),
	FAC_PWD as string (),
	FAC_SRVR as string (),
	FAC_USER as string (),
	SQLAddressAfter as string (),
	SQLAddressBefore as string ()
}

source(output(
		HIST_CREATE_DTM as timestamp,
		SBSB_CK as integer,
		SBAD_TYPE as string,
		SBAD_ADDR1 as string,
		SBAD_ADDR2 as string,
		SBAD_ADDR3 as string,
		SBAD_CITY as string,
		SBAD_STATE as string,
		SBAD_ZIP as string,
		SBAD_COUNTY as string,
		SBAD_PHONE as string,
		TXN1_ROW_ID as integer
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT DISTINCT sbad_b.hist_create_dtm,                  sbad_b.sbsb_ck,                  sbad_b.sbad_type,                  sbad_b.sbad_addr1,                  sbad_b.sbad_addr2,                  sbad_b.sbad_addr3,                  sbad_b.sbad_city,                  sbad_b.sbad_state,                  sbad_b.sbad_zip,                  sbad_b.sbad_county,                  sbad_b.sbad_phone, 	sbad_b.txn1_row_id  FROM   facets.au_cmc_sbad_addr sbad_b,         facets.cmc_meme_member meme,         facets.cmc_mepe_prcs_elig mepe  WHERE  meme.meme_ck = mepe.meme_ck         AND Upper(sbad_b.hist_image_cd) = \'B\'                AND  Upper(sbad_b.hist_log_act_cd) = \'U\'                AND  sbad_b.grgr_ck = 13                AND  mepe.grgr_ck = 13                AND  Upper(sbad_b.hist_usus_id) = \'FAAPP\'                AND  mepe.mepe_elig_ind = \'Y\'                AND  Substr(mepe.cspi_id, 0, 3) = \'TNL\'                AND  mepe.cscs_id = \'PL02\'              AND  sbad_b.hist_create_dtm > = Sysdate - 5 Order by sbad_b.sbsb_ck ,sbad_b.sbad_type, sbad_b.hist_create_dtm, sbad_b.txn1_row_id',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> OLEDBSourceAfter	source(output(
		HIST_CREATE_DTM as timestamp,
		SBSB_CK as integer,
		SBAD_TYPE as string,
		SBAD_ADDR1 as string,
		SBAD_ADDR2 as string,
		SBAD_ADDR3 as string,
		SBAD_CITY as string,
		SBAD_STATE as string,
		SBAD_ZIP as string,
		SBAD_COUNTY as string,
		SBAD_PHONE as string,
		TXN1_ROW_ID as integer
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	procedureName: 'TNLTC_GET_UPDATED_ADDRES',
	schemaName: 'AGP',
	resultSet: true,
	format: 'procedure',
	staged:false) ~> OLEDBSourceBefore
OLEDBSourceBefore,OLEDBSourceAfter join(OLEDBSourceBefore@SBSB_CK == OLEDBSourceAfter@SBSB_CK && OLEDBSourceBefore@SBAD_TYPE == OLEDBSourceAfter@SBAD_TYPE && OLEDBSourceBefore@HIST_CREATE_DTM == OLEDBSourceAfter@HIST_CREATE_DTM && OLEDBSourceBefore@TXN1_ROW_ID == OLEDBSourceAfter@TXN1_ROW_ID,
	joinType:'inner',
	broadcast: 'none')~> MergeJoin
MergeJoin select(mapColumn(
		{HIST_CREATE_DTM (1)} = {HIST_CREATE_DTM (1)},
		{SBSB_CK (1)} = {SBSB_CK (1)},
		{SBAD_TYPE (1)} = {SBAD_TYPE (1)},
		{SBAD_ADDR1 (1)} = {SBAD_ADDR1 (1)},
		{SBAD_ADDR2 (1)} = {SBAD_ADDR2 (1)},
		{SBAD_ADDR3 (1)} = {SBAD_ADDR3 (1)},
		{SBAD_CITY (1)} = {SBAD_CITY (1)},
		{SBAD_STATE (1)} = {SBAD_STATE (1)},
		{SBAD_ZIP (1)} = {SBAD_ZIP (1)},
		{SBAD_COUNTY (1)} = {SBAD_COUNTY (1)},
		{SBAD_PHONE (1)} = {SBAD_PHONE (1)},
		{TXN1_ROW_ID (1)} = {TXN1_ROW_ID (1)},
		HIST_CREATE_DTM = OLEDBSourceAfter@HIST_CREATE_DTM,
		SBSB_CK = OLEDBSourceAfter@SBSB_CK,
		SBAD_TYPE = OLEDBSourceAfter@SBAD_TYPE,
		SBAD_ADDR1 = OLEDBSourceAfter@SBAD_ADDR1,
		SBAD_ADDR2 = OLEDBSourceAfter@SBAD_ADDR2,
		SBAD_ADDR3 = OLEDBSourceAfter@SBAD_ADDR3,
		SBAD_CITY = OLEDBSourceAfter@SBAD_CITY,
		SBAD_STATE = OLEDBSourceAfter@SBAD_STATE,
		SBAD_ZIP = OLEDBSourceAfter@SBAD_ZIP,
		SBAD_COUNTY = OLEDBSourceAfter@SBAD_COUNTY,
		SBAD_PHONE = OLEDBSourceAfter@SBAD_PHONE,
		TXN1_ROW_ID = OLEDBSourceAfter@TXN1_ROW_ID
	),
	 skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	 skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> MergeJoinSelect
MergeJoinSelect derive({HIST_CREATE_DTM 1} = {HIST_CREATE_DTM 1},
		{SBSB_CK 1} = {SBSB_CK 1},
		{SBAD_TYPE 1} = {SBAD_TYPE 1},
		{SBAD_ADDR1 1} = {SBAD_ADDR1 1},
		{SBAD_ADDR2 1} = {SBAD_ADDR2 1},
		{SBAD_ADDR3 1} = {SBAD_ADDR3 1},
		{SBAD_CITY 1} = {SBAD_CITY 1},
		{SBAD_STATE 1} = {SBAD_STATE 1},
		{SBAD_ZIP 1} = {SBAD_ZIP 1},
		{SBAD_COUNTY 1} = {SBAD_COUNTY 1},
		{SBAD_PHONE 1} = {SBAD_PHONE 1},
		{TXN1_ROW_ID 1} = {TXN1_ROW_ID 1},
		HIST_CREATE_DTM = HIST_CREATE_DTM,
		SBSB_CK = SBSB_CK,
		SBAD_TYPE = SBAD_TYPE,
		SBAD_ADDR1 = SBAD_ADDR1,
		SBAD_ADDR2 = SBAD_ADDR2,
		SBAD_ADDR3 = SBAD_ADDR3,
		SBAD_CITY = SBAD_CITY,
		SBAD_STATE = SBAD_STATE,
		SBAD_ZIP = SBAD_ZIP,
		SBAD_COUNTY = SBAD_COUNTY,
		SBAD_PHONE = SBAD_PHONE,
		TXN1_ROW_ID = TXN1_ROW_ID) ~> MergeJoinREFORMAT1
MergeJoinREFORMAT1 split(SBAD_ADDR1 != SBAD_ADDR1 (1) || SBAD_ADDR2 != SBAD_ADDR2 (1) || SBAD_ADDR3 != SBAD_ADDR3 (1) || SBAD_CITY != SBAD_CITY (1) || SBAD_STATE != SBAD_STATE (1) || SBAD_ZIP != SBAD_ZIP (1) || SBAD_PHONE != SBAD_PHONE (1) || SBAD_COUNTY != SBAD_COUNTY (1), disjoint: true) ~> ConditionalSplit1@(Case1,ConditionalSplitDefaultOutput)
ConditionalSplit1@Case1 derive({SBAD_ADDR1 (1)} = {SBAD_ADDR1 (1)},
		{SBAD_STATE (1)} = {SBAD_STATE (1)},
		{SBAD_PHONE (1)} = {SBAD_PHONE (1)},
		SBAD_ZIP = SBAD_ZIP,
		{SBAD_COUNTY (1)} = {SBAD_COUNTY (1)},
		SBAD_ADDR1 = SBAD_ADDR1,
		SBAD_ADDR2 = SBAD_ADDR2,
		SBAD_ADDR3 = SBAD_ADDR3,
		SBAD_CITY = SBAD_CITY,
		SBAD_PHONE = SBAD_PHONE,
		{SBAD_ADDR2 (1)} = {SBAD_ADDR2 (1)},
		SBAD_STATE = SBAD_STATE,
		{SBAD_CITY (1)} = {SBAD_CITY (1)},
		{SBAD_ADDR3 (1)} = {SBAD_ADDR3 (1)},
		SBAD_COUNTY = SBAD_COUNTY,
		{SBAD_ZIP (1)} = {SBAD_ZIP (1)},
		{HIST_CREATE_DTM (1)} = {HIST_CREATE_DTM (1)},
		{SBSB_CK (1)} = {SBSB_CK (1)},
		{SBAD_TYPE (1)} = {SBAD_TYPE (1)},
		{TXN1_ROW_ID (1)} = {TXN1_ROW_ID (1)},
		HIST_CREATE_DTM = HIST_CREATE_DTM,
		SBSB_CK = SBSB_CK,
		SBAD_TYPE = SBAD_TYPE,
		TXN1_ROW_ID = TXN1_ROW_ID) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion sink(input(
		HIST_CREATE_DTM as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		SBAD_ZIP as string,
		SBAD_TYPE as string,
		SBAD_STATE as string,
		SBAD_ADDR1 as string,
		SBAD_ADDR2 as string,
		SBAD_ADDR3 as string,
		SBAD_COUNTY as string,
		SBAD_CITY as string,
		SBSB_CK as integer,
		SBAD_PHONE as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		HIST_CREATE_DTM,
		SBAD_ZIP,
		SBAD_TYPE,
		SBAD_STATE,
		SBAD_ADDR1,
		SBAD_ADDR2,
		SBAD_ADDR3,
		SBAD_COUNTY,
		SBAD_CITY,
		SBSB_CK,
		SBAD_PHONE)) ~> OLEDBDestination
